option.name: originalContent
option.value:
version: '3.8'
services: # PostgreSQL Database postgres: image: postgres:15-alpine container_name: simtools-postgres restart: unless-stopped environment: POSTGRES_DB: ${PG_DB:-simulators} POSTGRES_USER: ${PG_USER:-simtools_user} POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${PG_PASSWORD} volumes: - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data networks: - simtools-network healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${PG_USER:-simtools_user} -d ${PG_DB:-simulators}"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5
# MongoDB Database mongodb: image: mongo:7 container_name: simtools-mongodb restart: unless-stopped environment: MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: ${MONGO_USER:-simtools_mongo} MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MONGO_PASSWORD} MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE: ${MONGO_DB:-simulators} volumes: - mongo-data:/data/db networks: - simtools-network healthcheck: test: echo 'db.runCommand("ping").ok' | mongosh localhost:27017/test --quiet interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5
# Backend Service backend: image: ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPO_OWNER}/simtools-backend:${IMAGE_TAG:-latest} container_name: simtools-backend restart: unless-stopped env_file: - .env environment: - ENVIRONMENT=production - PG_HOST=postgres - MONGO_HOST=mongodb ports: - "127.0.0.1:8000:8000" volumes: - ./logs:/app/logs depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy mongodb: condition: service_healthy networks: - simtools-network healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/health"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 3 start_period: 40s
# Frontend Service frontend: image: ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPO_OWNER}/simtools-frontend:${IMAGE_TAG:-latest} container_name: simtools-frontend restart: unless-stopped environment: - NODE_ENV=production ports: - "127.0.0.1:3000:3000" depends_on: - backend networks: - simtools-network healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:3000"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 3
# Nginx Reverse Proxy nginx: image: nginx:alpine container_name: simtools-nginx restart: unless-stopped ports: - "80:80" - "443:443" volumes: - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro - ./ssl:/etc/nginx/ssl:ro - ./logs/nginx:/var/log/nginx depends_on: - backend - frontend networks: - simtools-network
networks: simtools-network: driver: bridge
volumes: postgres-data: driver: local mongo-data: driver: local
